♒ The Aquarius Cloth. OFFENSE/removal

Signature Technique

@UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Diamond Dust]

Cloth Passive — Cold Blood

You have cold resistance equal to your level and are immune to severe cold. You gain a +1 status bonus to Will saves against emotion effects, and you are trained in Occultism or Arcana (your choice).

Ascendant Boon — Freezing Coffin [OFFENSE/removal]

Any cold damage you deal forces a Fortitude save against your Cosmo DC; on a failure the creature is slowed 1. This is cumulative: at slowed 4 the creature is instead petrified in ice, which any critical hit shatters.

Your cold damage ignores cold resistance and treats cold immunity as resistance 10.

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Ascendant (Aquarius)]

Zenith Boon — Aurora Execution [removal]

As the Ascendant Boon, and you gain @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Aurora Execution], usable once per minute.

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Zenith (Aquarius)]

11th-Level Cloth Ability — Freezing Coffin

@UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Freezing Coffin]
